text: RESULTS: Hyperinflation of lungs. Flattened diaphragm. No focal lung opacities.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the X-ray; the hyperinflation suggests air trapping. Do you notice any wheezing when you breathe in or out, and have you noticed seasonal allergies or exposure to dust/chemicals? REQUEST TEST: Spirometry

text: The spirometry confirms obstructive lung disease. Have you been a smoker, or do you work in an environment with significant dust or chemical exposure? Additionally, do you have a family history of asthma or emphysema? REQUEST TEST: Alpha-1 Antitrypsin Level
